overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law when the Chair asked a disruptive board member to be silent and sought her removal, declined the constitutional claim, and closed the matter with no order.

allegations.summary: Alleged that the Chair violated the Open Meeting Law by trying to silence and remove a fellow board member during the September 27, 2012 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, the Chair did not violate the Open Meeting Law by asking Ms. Leukhardt to be silent, or by seeking her removal when she did not comply.

allegations.summary: Alleged that the attempt to silence and remove the board member violated that member's constitutional rights.
allegations.key_passage: The Division of Open Government only interprets and enforces the Open Meeting Law, thus we decline to review allegations of violation of any other laws.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
